answer: Reaching the zenith of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the basalt of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit.
